purpose: Record the narrow authority that can be closed from the small F1 generated XML/Def files and official BI4 storage source, while keeping producer world-axis calibration and numerical qualification unknown.

allowed: small generated.xml and source Def.xml records for F1-S1 and F1-S2
small official C++ source/header records for JPartDataBi4 storage types

native_storage_component_order.meaning: JPartDataBi4 stores Idp, Posd, Vel, and Rhop through the official source path; tdouble3/tfloat3 define ordered x,y,z components.

position_unit.basis: F1 source Def geometry definition declares metres (m); generated case geometry is the same source-bound geometry.

gravity_unit.basis: Each generated F1 XML carries the source gravity vector and its m/s^2 unit comment.

density_unit.basis: Generated XML rhop0 carries the kg/m^3 unit comment.

mass_unit.basis: Generated XML massfluid/massbound carry the kg unit comment; ROOT207 independently verified native header mass fields for the selected records.

velocity_unit.basis: The observer contract and solver convention use m/s, but the generated XML has no independent velocity unit attribute.

time_unit.basis: RunPARTs/decoded_s are used as seconds by the existing observer contract; frame index is not time and no event characteristic T is supplied.

producer_world_axis_orientation.basis: The XML labels gravity components x,y,z and the registered contract uses an identity world rotation, but JPartDataBi4/bi4_dump carries no producer-to-world orientation record. Gravity alone cannot independently prove orientation.

mapping.moving: no moving/floating block in these static F1 generated XMLs

typed_role_authority.identity_rule: Do not combine relative fluid MK with absolute MK. Fixed and fluid roles are disjoint XML ranges; ROOT207 proof supplies the selected native Idp/count identity join without this sidecar reading native payloads.
typed_role_authority.mass_scope: Native header mass and fluid weighted fields are discrete sample diagnostics. They do not establish a continuum-owner mass for F1-S2 or a physical Q.

control_scope.motion: No moving/floating control tag is present in the bound F1 generated XMLs; this is a static-control source fact, not a claim that all physical numerical effects are absent.

root207_binding.allowed_scope: Five selected native-header/role/mass/weighted-observation conditions; producer world-axis calibration remains UNKNOWN; no QI/QN/QE credit.

minimum_next_gate.smallest_information_gain: Find and bind an actual producer writer/case source record that declares how solver x,y,z map to the physical world, with exact source SHA/stat and the existing ROOT207 asymmetric selected-frame join. Do not infer this mapping from gravity or from the identity contract alone.
minimum_next_gate.if_no_axis_record_exists: Keep world-axis calibration UNKNOWN and restrict any F1 sidecar to component-space, typed-role, native-header, mass, and saved-time diagnostics.
minimum_next_gate.numerical_error: Existing ROOT207 selected fields and XML control closure do not identify integration, output, or spatial error bounds. A neighboring-grid difference is not a truth estimate; saved-time brackets are not interpolation or exact common-time values. Use the already frozen F1 task contract without widening it before any future observation.
